changes: Fit a size- and layout-contained clock from its own native observation, preserving custom-container fallback.
Yield between shared UI stages instead of chaining sorting and name layout in one task.
Prioritize score messages over background metadata, retaining dependency and wire-order checks.
Skip periodic compaction only for lifecycle-tracked files unchanged since a successful rewrite; failed writes and concurrent appends stay dirty.
Allow observed names to progress through required UI stages in bounded frames during a continuing receive stream.
Complete already measurable names in the same finished-list frame after initial layout.
Coalesce finished-list sorting to at most once per native frame, retaining all owned work and receipts.
Keep at most one BTP login in flight during overlapping request failures; retain the existing retry delay and readback-before-outbox order.
Replay all persisted BTP needsync metadata as well as results and calls, so interrupted unfinished-match changes are not permanently skipped.
Permit committed readonly snapshots while certified pure staged compaction runs; block reads that would bypass earlier scoped writes.
Assemble full admin responses from immutable UTF8 fragments, preserving every native JSON byte and explicit WebSocket text frames.
Retain date headers when their leading finished match changes; bound compositor layers to table wrappers instead of individual rows.
Prepare owned event-catalog delivery variants cooperatively before allocation locks. Publish and advance recipient baselines only after actual validated database writes, within the original executor.
